method: ENGINEERING: all recoveries, standing poses, suppressed patrols, projected exit visibility and timer/health states arranged. Native FIRE,DASH,pause,map and retry; actual Custodian volley resolution, phase interrupt and resolved rifle damage. No ordinary mission, human reaction-time or enjoyment claim. HUD is sampled at its existing10Hz refresh; pure formatting truncates the captured value. A temporary deliberately colliding caption is a fixture negative control, removed before final capture.

checks.name: current opening timer and meter fit existing strip and leave coil cells readable
real-time decay enters amber short window and closes without predicting the next opening or rebuilding coil cells
actual volley resolution and native phase break retain2.6/3second rules and share the fixed scale
native FIRE crossing the closing boundary still resolves armor damage and the clock reports closed
arranged occluded objective hides precise clock; charge warning retains priority and restores visible countdown coherently
native pause and planning freeze actual timer, hide live strip and resume without a new window
actual last-coil kill returns the same strip to real upload percent and removes exposure semantics
native fresh and earned retry clear old window display rather than carrying the previous countdown
